SignIn.tagline: Track your training programs and log your sessions.
SignIn.error: Sign-in didn’t complete. Please try again.
SignIn.passwordless: Google is the only way in. We never see or store a password.

Pwa.body: Install Workount for a faster, offline-ready app.
Pwa.iosInstructions: Install Workount: tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen".

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.languageDescription: The language the app is displayed in.

Programs.title: Programs
Programs.emptyBody: Create your first program to start planning workouts.
Programs.workoutsEmpty: No workouts yet — you’ll add them next.
Programs.switchNote: Following this replaces {name} as your active program.
Programs.archiveHint: Hides the program from your list. Its history is kept.
Programs.deleteWorkoutConfirm: Delete this workout? Sessions performed from it are kept.
Programs.workoutExercisesEmpty: No exercises yet — you'll add them next.

ExercisePicker.title: Add exercise
ExercisePicker.didYouMean: Did you mean one of these?
ExercisePicker.duplicateError: You already have a custom exercise with this name.

PrescriptionEditor.supersetLonelyWarning: Group {group} needs a second exercise to alternate with.
PrescriptionEditor.repRangeError: Rep max must be at least rep min.
PrescriptionEditor.removeConfirm: Remove this exercise from the workout? Sessions performed from it are kept.
PrescriptionEditor.invalidError: Check the values and try again.
PrescriptionEditor.notFoundError: This exercise was removed. Refresh and try again.

Home.noProgramBody: Create a program to get a recommendation here every time you open the app.
Home.resumeBody: {minutes, plural, =0 {Started just now} one {# min} other {# min}}
Home.startError: Couldn't start the session. Check your connection and try again.
Home.streakValue: {days, plural, =0 {No streak yet} one {# day} other {# days}}

WorkoutDetail.startSessionError: Couldn't start the session. Check your connection and try again.

Session.emptyBody: Start a workout to begin logging sets.
Session.editingHint: Editing — save or cancel above to keep logging
Session.finishBody: Check the last set before you save — a completed session can't be edited.
Session.finishError: Couldn't save — check your connection and try again. Your session is safe on this device.

History.title: History
History.emptyBody: Finish a workout and it'll show up here.

Analytics.title: Analytics
Analytics.emptyBody: Finish a session in this program and your numbers show up here.
Analytics.notEnoughBody: Come back after a few more sessions — two points aren’t a trend.
Analytics.strengthSubtitle: Estimated 1RM per session. Estimated from your top set — not a max you lifted.
Analytics.neverPerformedBody: No working sets of this exercise in this program so far.
Analytics.noExercisesBody: Add exercises to this program’s workouts and they’ll be charted here.
Analytics.volumeSubtitle: Per session, working sets only. Warmups don’t count.
Analytics.prsSubtitle: Your best working sets, across every program.
Analytics.prNone: No records for this exercise yet.
Analytics.adherenceSubtitle: Sessions completed against the {count, plural, one {# workout} other {# workouts}} this program schedules each week.
Analytics.adherenceUnscheduled: This program schedules no workouts to a day, so there’s nothing to measure against.
